channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Live: Men’s hockey, men’s curling tournaments get underway at the 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Goalie Filip Gustavsson, one of eight Wild players at the Milan Cortina Games, started for Sweden in its opening win vs. Italy. Team USA starts its tournament Thursday.

item.title: Eaux Claires music fest’s return is just a pull tab away
item.description: Scheduled July 24-25 after an eight-year hiatus, Justin “Bon Iver” Vernon’s festival lineup will be revealed on cardboard at an Eau Claire bar.

item.title: Poll: Trump’s immigration crackdown deeply unpopular in Minnesota
item.description: Federal deportation efforts are also unpopular nationally, turning immigration from a political strength to a problem for the president ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: KARE 11 hires new sports anchor
item.description: Ashley Moore previously worked in Denver.

item.title: New Trump administration rule will bar green-card holders from applying for SBA loans
item.description: The new rule, which goes into effect March 1, says only firms owned by citizens or U.S. nationals will qualify for Small Business Administration loans.

item.title: ‘Crazy fast’ ICE chase in St. Paul ends with multi-vehicle crash, fleeing driver injured
item.description: A witness said the motorist was “barreling down the road” before colliding in the intersection with another vehicle.

item.title: Minneapolis’ public hospital plans to cut 100 beds in latest HCMC budget cuts
item.description: Minneapolis-based Hennepin Healthcare says it also will suspend contributions to some worker retirement plans while pausing $24 million in capital projects.

item.title: With ICE presence continuing, Minnesota Girl Scouts offer more ways to buy cookies as safety precaution
item.description: In-person sales start Feb. 20 throughout the state.

item.title: The latest: Border czar plans Thursday morning news conference
item.description: An anti-ICE protest at the Richfield Target led to several arrests on Wednesday evening.

item.title: After assault allegations, DOJ walks back charges against ICE protesters
item.description: Defense attorneys and former federal prosecutors say the U.S. Department of Justice’s public rhetoric about “Minnesota rioters” isn’t matching the evidence.
